_note: This file is a pure configuration file (dict literals only). It defines model settings for a UPerNet with VisionTransformer backbone (ViT-B/16) for semantic segmentation in the MMSegmentation framework. There are no callable functions, classes, or APIs — only data structures imported by the framework at runtime.
config_model_settings: configure the UPerNet ViT-B/16 model settings for semantic segmentation with 19 classes
config_backbone_vit: configure the VisionTransformer backbone with 768 embed dims and 12 layers
config_decode_head: configure the UPerHead decode head with multi-scale pyramid pooling for segmentation
config_auxiliary_head: configure the FCNHead auxiliary head for auxiliary loss during training
config_data_preprocessor: configure the SegDataPreProcessor with ImageNet mean/std normalization
